title: Steering cities towards net-zero: unravelling the causal impact of green fiscal policy on urban decarbonization in China
title_zh: 引导城市迈向净零排放：揭示绿色财政政策对中国城市脱碳的因果影响
authors: Xin Cheng, Yi Chen, Han Zhang
abstract: Amid the growing urgency of climate change and the global pursuit of net-zero emissions, green fiscal policy (GFP) has become an important instrument for sustainable development. This study examines the effect of GFP on urban carbon emission mitigation (UCEM), with particular attention to its mechanisms and heterogeneous impacts. Using panel data for 274 Chinese prefecture-level cities from 2002 to 2022, it employs the Comprehensive Demonstration of Fiscal Policy for Energy Conservation and Emission Reduction as a quasi-natural experiment and applies a difference-in-differences approach. The results show that GFP significantly promotes UCEM, with stronger effects in cities characterized by higher pollution levels. Mechanism analysis indicates that green innovation and lower total energy consumption serve as positive channels, whereas government environmental attention plays a negative mediating role. In addition, entrepreneurial activity strengthens the effect of GFP, while fiscal pressure weakens it. These findings support phased GFP expansion, stricter enforcement in high-pollution cities, stronger incentives in low-pollution areas, improved transparency and supervision, innovation-led efficiency and clean-energy substitution, plus flexible financing to sustain decarbonization. KEYWORDS: Green fiscal policy carbon emission mitigation urban decarbonization sustainable development JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q54 Q58 R11
abstract_zh: 在气候变化日益紧迫与全球追求净零排放的背景下，绿色财政政策已成为推动可持续发展的重要工具。本研究考察了绿色财政政策对城市碳减排的影响，重点关注其作用机制与异质性效应。基于2002至2022年中国274个地级市的面板数据，以节能减排财政政策综合示范作为准自然实验，采用双重差分方法进行分析。结果表明，绿色财政政策显著促进了城市碳减排，且在污染程度较高的城市中效果更为显著。机制分析显示，绿色创新与总能源消耗降低是正向传导渠道，而政府环境关注度则发挥负向中介作用。此外，创业活动强化了绿色财政政策的效应，而财政压力则削弱了该效应。这些发现支持分阶段推进绿色财政政策扩张、在高污染城市加强执行力度、在低污染地区强化激励措施、提升透明度与监管水平、以创新驱动效率提升与清洁能源替代，以及通过灵活融资维持脱碳进程。关键词：绿色财政政策；碳减排；城市脱碳；可持续发展 JEL分类：Q54 Q58 R11

title: Job Ladder and Wealth Dynamics in General Equilibrium
title_zh: 一般均衡中的职业阶梯与财富动态
authors: Leo Kaas, Etienne Lalé, Nawid Siassi
abstract: This paper develops a macroeconomic model that combines an incomplete‐markets overlapping‐generations economy with a job ladder featuring sequential wage bargaining, endogenous search effort of employed and non‐employed workers, and differences in match quality. With these ingredients, our model provides a joint microfoundation for the three main inputs in aggregate production: capital, employment, and labor efficiency. The calibrated model offers a good fit to the empirical age profiles of search activity, job‐finding rates, wages, and savings. We use the model to analyze the impact of tax and transfer policies for labor market dynamics and aggregate economic activity via capital, employment, and labor efficiency channels. Lower unemployment benefits and a less progressive tax schedule bring about welfare losses for a newborn worker which are mainly driven by higher consumption risk and costlier search effort; both policies have differential effects along the age, income, and wealth dimensions.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个宏观经济学模型，该模型将不完全市场的世代交叠经济与包含序贯工资谈判、就业与非就业工人内生搜寻努力以及匹配质量差异的工作阶梯相结合。基于这些要素，我们的模型为总生产中的三个主要投入——资本、就业和劳动效率——提供了统一的微观基础。校准后的模型较好地拟合了搜寻活动、工作找到率、工资和储蓄的年龄分布经验特征。我们利用该模型分析税收与转移支付政策通过资本、就业和劳动效率渠道对劳动力市场动态及总体经济活动的影响。降低失业救济金和减少税收累进性会给新生工人带来福利损失，这主要源于更高的消费风险和更昂贵的搜寻努力；这两种政策在年龄、收入和财富维度上具有差异化效应。

title: Sharing Model Uncertainty
authors: Chiaki Hara, Sujoy Mukerji, Frank Riedel, Jean-Marc Tallon
abstract: This paper examines efficient allocations in economies where consumers exhibit heterogeneous smooth ambiguity preferences and face model uncertainty with a common set of identifiable models. Aggregate endowment is ambiguous. We characterize economies where the representative consumer is of the smooth ambiguity type and derive efficient sharing rules. Heterogeneous ambiguity aversion leads to sharing rules that systematically differ from those in vNM economies. The representative consumer’s ambiguity aversion differs from that of the typical consumer; this leads to more compelling asset-pricing predictions. We focus on point-identified models but show that our insights extend to partially identified models. (JEL D11, D61, D81, E32, G12)
abstract_zh: 本文研究了消费者具有异质性平滑模糊偏好且面临共同可识别模型集下的模型不确定性时的经济有效配置问题。总禀赋具有模糊性。我们刻画了代表性消费者属于平滑模糊类型的经济体特征，并推导出有效的风险分担规则。异质性模糊厌恶导致的风险分担规则与vNM经济体中的规则存在系统性差异。代表性消费者的模糊厌恶程度与典型消费者不同，这产生了更具说服力的资产定价预测。本文重点研究点识别模型，但论证了相关见解可推广至部分识别模型。（JEL分类号：D11, D61, D81, E32, G12）

title: Psychosocial Health and Well-Being After A Mortality Shock
title_zh: 死亡率冲击后的社会心理健康与福祉
authors: Elizabeth Frankenberg, Cecep Sumantri, Duncan Thomas
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We investigate the short- and long-run impacts of unexpected mortality on psychosocial health in the context of a large-scale high-mortality natural disaster, the 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami. The effects of the tsunami-related mortality measured at the community level are contrasted with the effects of individual-specific loss of close kin using population-representative longitudinal survey data from the Study of the Tsunami Aftermath and Recovery. In the short-run, two years post-tsunami, both community and individual-level mortality exposures are significant predictors of elevated depression and post-traumatic stress symtoms. In the longer-run, ten years post-tsunami, individual-level exposures are slightly attenuated but remain significant predictors of both psychosocial health measures; in contrast, community-level mortality predicts post-traumatic stress but not depression symptoms. Mortality is linked to smaller household sizes in the short- and long-run and to less social support in the long-run, although the latter effect differs substantially for males and females. The estimates adjust for other tsunami exposure measures and, in the individual-level analyses, we compare people living in the same community at the time of the tsunami who were exposed to the same community-level mortality rate.
abstract_zh: 本文以2004年印度洋地震海啸这一大规模高死亡率自然灾害为背景，考察意外死亡对心理社会健康的短期与长期影响。通过使用"海啸后果与恢复研究"中具有人口代表性的纵向调查数据，我们将社区层面测量的海啸相关死亡率影响与个体层面近亲丧失的影响进行对比。在短期（海啸后两年）内，社区与个体层面的死亡暴露均是抑郁症状与创伤后应激症状加剧的显著预测因子。在长期（海啸后十年）内，个体层面暴露的影响虽略有减弱，但仍对两项心理健康指标具有显著预测作用；相比之下，社区层面死亡率仅能预测创伤后应激症状，而非抑郁症状。死亡率与短期及长期的家庭规模缩小相关，并与长期的社会支持减少相关，但后者在男女性别间存在显著差异。本研究在估计中调整了其他海啸暴露指标，并在个体层面分析中，比较了海啸发生时居住于同一社区且面临相同社区死亡率的居民。

title: Dynamic linkage and risk transmission mechanisms between crude oil and China – U.S. stock markets: a multi-scale perspective
title_zh: 原油与中美股市的动态联动及风险传导机制：多尺度视角
authors: Meng Wan, Jiaxi Sun, Cong Sui
abstract: Investigating the dynamic linkage between international crude oil prices and stock markets is crucial for mitigating cross-market systemic risks. Based on weekly data from 11 January 2002, to 13 October 2023, this paper develops an integrated analytical framework combining wavelet decomposition, DCC-GARCH, and quantile time-frequency spillover methods to systematically examine the oil – stock nexus. The main findings are as follows: First, the correlation between oil prices and stock returns exhibits significant frequency dependence. In the short term, the correlation is positive, whereas it turns negative in the long term. Second, the relationship between oil price changes and stock markets varies with the underlying drivers of oil price shocks. Demand-driven oil price increases are primarily associated with positive correlations, whereas supply-driven increases are more often associated with negative correlations. Third, VIX is positively associated with market co-movement, while GPR shows the opposite effect. Fourth, the correlation between oil prices and U.S. stocks is stronger than that between oil prices and Chinese stocks, possibly reflecting China’s policy interventions and differences in market structure. Moreover, the U.S. stock market is the primary source of global risk spillovers, while the Chinese stock market is primarily a net receiver of risk.
abstract_zh: 探究国际原油价格与股票市场之间的动态关联对于缓解跨市场系统性风险至关重要。基于2002年1月11日至2023年10月13日的周度数据，本文构建了融合小波分解、DCC-GARCH模型及分位数时频溢出方法的综合分析框架，系统考察了石油-股票市场的关联机制。主要发现如下：第一，油价与股票收益的相关性呈现显著频率依赖性。短期表现为正相关，而长期则转为负相关。第二，油价变动与股票市场的关系随油价冲击的驱动因素不同而存在差异。需求驱动的油价上涨主要伴随正相关，而供给驱动的油价上涨则更多呈现负相关。第三，VIX指数与市场联动性呈正相关，而GPR指数则呈现相反效应。第四，油价与美国股市的相关性强于其与中国股市的相关性，这或可归因于中国的政策干预及市场结构差异。此外，美国股市是全球风险溢出的主要来源，而中国股市则主要扮演风险净接收者的角色。

title: A simple proof of the sufficiency of Dilmé’s power-sequence test for Kreps-Wilson consistency
title_zh: 迪尔梅幂序列检验对克雷普斯-威尔逊一致性充分性的一个简单证明
abstract: Dilmé (Internat J Game Theory 53:673 2024) shows that an assessment is Kreps-Wilson (1982) consistent if and only if it is the limit of a particularly simple kind of sequence of strictly mixed strategies—which Dilmé calls a “power sequence”—and its associated sequence of Bayes-rule induced beliefs. We use Farkas’ lemma to provide a brief and simple proof of Dilmé’s result.
abstract_zh: 迪尔梅（《国际博弈论杂志》第53卷，第673页，2024年）证明，一个评估是克雷普斯-威尔逊（1982）一致的，当且仅当它是某种特别简单的严格混合策略序列——迪尔梅称之为“幂序列”——及其关联的贝叶斯规则诱导信念序列的极限。我们利用法卡斯引理，为迪尔梅的这一结果提供了一个简洁而简单的证明。
